brief:
Doctors Without Borders has warned that Israeli authorities' continued restrictions on engine oils and spare parts entering Gaza pose serious health risks to thousands of Palestinians, the Shehab Wire reported. The organization said the limitations increase dangers of death and serious illness among the population, compounding existing humanitarian challenges in the territory.

Medical facilities in Gaza already face severe resource shortages that have strained their ability to provide care. The organization's warning underscores how supply restrictions affect the broader health system's capacity to treat patients and maintain essential equipment and operations across the enclave.
